text:
ophelia: Heads-up — we started seeing a small wave of decrypt failures for onprem keystore agent after the KMS operator rotation at ~17:03. Services in the eu-west private cluster saw transient 403/decrypt errors. Not a full outage but customer-facing latencies spiked. Trying to triage.
ash_sre: Seeing the same in metrics. Keystore agent logs show TLS handshake timeouts to the HSM proxy, then fallback to local cache which exhausted quickly. Example from node-5:
```:
keystore-agent[1]: 2025-11-03T17:04:12Z ERROR handshake failed: tls: handshake timeout
keystore-agent[1]: 2025-11-03T17:04:45Z WARN cache miss for key xyz
```
maria_sec: Any recent netpol or conntrack churn in that vlan? Also did the KMS operator roll change RBAC/serviceAccount bindings? Those often break the key handshake.
alex_infra: We had a small netpol tighten rolled 17:00 to block outbound 6443->HSM-proxy on the private edge (intended to block unexpected egress). Looks like rule CIDR was overly broad and impacted the keystore subnet. Reverting now.
ophelia: Confirmed: when I temporarily opened egress to the HSM proxy IP the handshake resumed. So it's netpol-related + tight timing with the rotation. But we also saw some audit events not forwarded — missing decrypt events in the SIEM for a 2m window.
security-bot: SIEM alert: "keystore.decrypt.failure" spike 17:03-17:06 (count=231). Forwarding link: https://siem.example/alerts/KEystore-178246
prateek_eng: If netpol caused connection fails during rotation, agent retries could conflict with operator rekey; we should avoid rekeys during egress policy changes. We should add gating that validates keystore connectivity before operator rotation resumes.
maria_sec: Agreed. Action items: (1) roll back netpol tweak (done), (2) add a pre-rotation smoke test to KMS operator runbook that checks decrypt/handshake, (3) ensure audit-forwarder buffers locally so we don't have gaps.
alex_infra: I'll open a PR to add the smoke test and a canary stage for operator rollouts. Also going to add a short-lived exception-annotation for netpol changes that touch the keystore-subnet.
ash_sre: For immediate mitigation we enabled a short client-side cache extension and bumped agent reconnect backoff to reduce thundering retries. That cut the error rate by ~70%.
ophelia: We should also look at RBAC: operator create/update perms allowed a controller to rotate keys without a cross-check. Suggest we require a separate keystore-operator-sa with scoped perms and audit annotation on any rotation event.
prateek_eng: I'll prototype RBAC change: separate SA + OPA gate that requires "keystore:connectivity=ok" annotation. Will include audit log emission on rotation start/complete. Also will add HSM handshake logs to the audit-events stream.
maria_sec: Also surface this in the private-deploy hardening checklist: require network policy whitelist tests in CI and a step to verify audit log forwarding (syslog/HTTPS) before cert rotations.
ophelia: Logging note — attach these snippets to the incident: `journalctl -u keystore-agent | grep handshake` and our SIEM export. We'll run a tabletop next Tuesday to tighten playbook.
security-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-1123-keystore-netpol (priority: P2) — assigned to ophelia, alex_infra, maria_sec.
ophelia: Thanks. I'll update the runbook with a postmortem template and link the PRs once they're up. TL;DR: root cause = netpol tighten + operator rotation timing; mitigations = revert netpol, rate-limit retries, add pre-rotation smoke test, scoped RBAC for operator, improve audit buffering/forwarding.
